content.text: I shouldn't be able to use fable 5.1 because I don't have credits.

I can't see your account, your plan, or your credit balance, so I can't tell you why you have access. What I can confirm is that this session runs on Claude Fable 5.1.

Some likely explanations:

- **Your plan may include it.** Usage credits usually pay for extra usage once you go past your plan's included limits. Having no credits doesn't always mean you can't use a model inside those limits.
- **Access may be temporary.** It could come from a trial, a promotion, or a rollout. When it ends, or when you hit a limit, Claude Code may block requests or switch you to another model.
- **The model setting may differ from what you expect.** Run this in Claude Code to see which model is active and change it:

```
/model
```

To get a real answer, check two places. The usage page that the command printed shows your limits and credits. Running `/status` in Claude Code shows your account and plan. If those pages say you shouldn't have access and you're worried about surprise charges, contact Anthropic support. They can see your billing and I can't.
